acceptance_criteria.description: Given a fixture index with known neighbors, When match_photo submits an enrolled animal's held-out photo, Then the ranked list matches the direct pipeline's output for the same inputs (ids and order).
Given any successful match response, When inspected, Then it carries similarity per candidate, the advisory string, and the species baseline metadata.
Given a match call completes, When the filesystem and DB are audited, Then no submitted image bytes, query embeddings, or EXIF-bearing artifacts were written.
Given the embed service is stopped, When match_photo is called, Then a typed degraded error returns within 5 s and a subsequent search_pets call still succeeds.
Given a non-image payload and an oversized image, When submitted, Then each yields a typed validation error and the server stays up.
Given the ryzen7 harness cross-session pairs, When run through the MCP path, Then ranked-list parity ≥99% and the divergence report lists every non-matching pair.
Given a warm embed service, When 50 timed matches run, Then p95 < 4 s.
Given limit=5 and a radius filter, When applied, Then survivors keep their kNN relative order.

root_motivation: The matcher is homeward's core value (baselines: r5 0.693, r20 0.880 — a 20-candidate shortlist finds an enrolled pet ~7 times in 8) yet it is unreachable from any agent: the embed service listens on the hub's loopback-adjacent :8741 and no public calling surface exists. An owner's assistant holding a photo today has no programmatic route to the shortlist. Evidence: homeward-ops service inventory + eval baselines (2026-08-26); embed service and HNSW index live since the original embed/match PRDs.
